questions.question: Where is the main drawing-processing pipeline defined, and what public method runs it?
expected_answer_points: DrawingPipeline is defined in src/pipeline.py.
DrawingPipeline.run is the public method that processes one PDF.

questions.question: Which function changes the JSON and CSV output directories beneath a caller-supplied base directory?
expected_answer_points: ApplicationConfig.with_output_directory performs the change.
It returns a replaced immutable config with <base>/json and <base>/csv paths.

questions.question: Where are the command-line exit codes for rejected drawings and export failures selected?
expected_answer_points: main.py selects the process exit codes in main().
Rejected drawings return 2, unsuccessful exports return 3, and other completed runs return 0.

questions.question: Which helper sanitizes an uploaded filename and enforces a PDF suffix?
expected_answer_points: app._safe_pdf_name performs upload filename sanitization.
It strips path components, requires a case-insensitive .pdf suffix, replaces unsafe stem characters, and rejects an unusable stem.

questions.question: How does PdfValidator distinguish ordinary invalid inputs from unexpected failures, and what conditions cause a likely-scanned rejection?
expected_answer_points: Expected invalid cases are returned as PdfValidationResult.rejected with a machine-readable PdfRejectionCode rather than raised.
PyMuPDF file errors become INVALID_PDF and unexpected exceptions become VALIDATION_ERROR.
A page is considered likely scanned only when it is both below minimum text density and at or above maximum image coverage.

questions.question: How does BOMExtractor find a BOM header and decide whether a candidate table row is valid?
expected_answer_points: It normalizes label tokens, finds aligned header-label clusters, and requires item number plus quantity plus at least one descriptive field.
It chooses the strongest valid cluster and derives columns from ordered header centers.
Rows are grouped geometrically, assigned to columns, required to match the item-number pattern, and rejected when a present quantity is not numeric.

questions.question: How does TitleBlockExtractor limit its search region and choose labeled values before using fallbacks?
expected_answer_points: It restricts candidate words to a configured lower-page title-block region.
It finds normalized label matches and scores nearby candidates using geometry and field validation.
Conservative regex fallbacks are applied only for fields still missing after labeled extraction.

questions.question: How does MaterialAggregator choose between BOM data and the title block, normalize materials, and handle incomplete quantities?
expected_answer_points: When any BOM rows exist it always aggregates BOM rows; only an empty BOM can fall back to a concrete usable title-block material.
Material values are uppercased, punctuation/whitespace normalized, aliases applied, and BOM-reference or ignored values excluded.
Equivalent materials are grouped with one-based source row positions.
A total is returned only if every contributing quantity parses successfully; otherwise the group quantity is None.

questions.question: How does OutputExporter create JSON and CSV without leaving a partially written target file?
expected_answer_points: It derives canonical JSON from DrawingResult and derives CSV from that JSON-compatible payload.
It creates destination directories and converts directory/write failures into OutputExportResult.failed.
Each target is written to a temporary file in the destination directory, flushed and fsynced, then atomically replaced with os.replace.

questions.question: What stages does DrawingPipeline.run execute, where can it stop early, and does an export failure change the extraction status?
expected_answer_points: The pipeline validates the PDF, extracts layout, extracts title block and BOM, aggregates materials, builds DrawingResult, and optionally exports.
Failed PDF validation or failed/missing layout stops extraction early with a rejected DrawingResult.
Unexpected deterministic extraction exceptions are converted to a rejected result.
_finish returns the drawing plus export outcome; an export failure does not rewrite DrawingResult.status.

questions.question: How does the central application configuration reach each configurable pipeline stage, and which stage is intentionally constructed without a config object?
expected_answer_points: ApplicationConfig groups validator, title block, BOM, materials, and output configuration objects.
DrawingPipeline.from_config passes those objects into the matching component constructors.
LayoutExtractor is not configured through ApplicationConfig and is left to DrawingPipeline's default construction.

questions.question: Trace a Streamlit upload from the browser bytes through the drawing pipeline to the downloadable JSON and CSV bytes.
expected_answer_points: process_upload sanitizes the name, creates a TemporaryDirectory, and writes the uploaded bytes to a temporary PDF.
It redirects ApplicationConfig output beneath the temporary root and runs DrawingPipeline.
On successful export it reads the generated JSON and CSV into memory before the temporary directory is removed.
The returned ProcessedUpload is rendered through Streamlit download buttons.

questions.question: How does the CLI's --output-directory option alter output paths, and how does the CLI distinguish extraction rejection from output-writing failure?
expected_answer_points: main._pipeline_for_output_directory calls ApplicationConfig.with_output_directory and constructs DrawingPipeline from that config.
The config changes output paths to the supplied base directory's json and csv children.
DrawingStatus.REJECTED produces exit code 2, while an unsuccessful non-null export outcome produces exit code 3.

questions.question: How is source provenance carried from PDF layout words into extracted title-block and BOM fields?
expected_answer_points: LayoutExtractor produces LayoutWord objects with page number, text, bounding box, and stable block/line/word positions.
Both extractors combine the bounding boxes of matched words and create ExtractedField values with MATCHED status and a Citation containing page and bbox.
Missing cells/fields have MISSING status and no citation.

questions.question: Describe the system's end-to-end data flow from an input PDF to the canonical result and optional output files, including the responsibility of each major stage.
expected_answer_points: PdfValidator gates unsupported inputs without doing extraction.
LayoutExtractor converts the accepted page into reusable words, text blocks, vector drawings, images, and page geometry.
TitleBlockExtractor and BOMExtractor interpret that shared layout independently.
MaterialAggregator produces the raw-material summary and DrawingPipeline creates the canonical DrawingResult/status.
OutputExporter optionally writes canonical JSON and a derived material CSV.

questions.question: What design boundaries keep PDF acceptance, layout measurement, engineering-field extraction, and persistence separate?
expected_answer_points: PdfValidator only decides whether input is acceptable and reports measurements/rejection reasons.
LayoutExtractor records PDF geometry and content without interpreting engineering fields.
TitleBlockExtractor and BOMExtractor consume the layout without reopening the PDF.
OutputExporter persists an already-built DrawingResult and does not change extraction semantics.

questions.question: How does the application upload exported drawing results to Amazon S3, and which retry policy does it use?
expected_answer_points: The repository contains no Amazon S3 upload implementation or cloud retry policy.
OutputExporter writes JSON and CSV to local filesystem paths only.

questions.question: Which OCR neural network preprocesses scanned drawings, and how is that model configured?
expected_answer_points: There is no OCR model or scanned-drawing preprocessing implementation.
The validator rejects likely scanned or textless PDFs instead of applying OCR.
